name: UpdateServiceNowUser
label: Update ServiceNow User
description: Updates an existing user in ServiceNow by sys_id using the provided CredentialId directly.

fields.name: CredentialId
fields.label: Credential
fields.description: The stored ServiceNow credential (Base64 token or OAuth2 token)

fields.name: UserId
fields.label: User ID
fields.description: The sys_id of the user to update

fields.name: UpdateFields
fields.label: Fields to Update
fields.description: List of key-value pairs representing field names and values to update.

fields.name: Response
fields.label: API Response
fields.description: Raw JSON response from ServiceNow API

fields.name: UpdatedUser
fields.label: Updated User
fields.description: The updated user record as JObject
